title: Close-out's own commits are never held for green CI
description:
Found by tick 0iz (run epic-9pd, attempt 3).

0iz admits the close-out phase only when CI is green on the epic PR's head as it stands when close-out STARTS. The close-out job then commits the retro and learnings, those integrate onto the epic branch, CI re-runs on the PR — and nothing holds the close for that final result. The rule covers everything except the last phase's own writes.

The pwp run showed why the gap is not theoretical: a close-out commit can break CI (a learnings file over a checked cap, a malformed tracker record, a public-repo guard hit — the guard failed on that run's own records). Gate the close-out's CLOSE on green CI for the head that includes its own commits.
acceptance_criteria: A close-out whose own commits turn the PR's CI red is not closed, and the refusal names the failing job; a test drives a close-out commit that fails CI and asserts the close is held
